note: Outside the stated ICP on every criterion, and the most clear-cut exclusion in the batch. The stated definition's explicit carve-out is 'It's not like we have dudes who come here who are 50 pounds overweight, who are just like, I need to just lose weight and I hate working out.' This prospect is 268 lb at six feet, has been overweight since childhood, has never been skinny at any point in his life, and states his goal as losing eighty pounds — more than the excluded threshold, not less. Good_to_great fails for the same reason and by his own framing: this is rescue from a fifteen-year decline, not optimisation. Neglected_health fails the severity test decisively — hypertension requiring daily medication, diagnosed sleep apnea requiring CPAP, two years of knee problems, a restricted shoulder and chronic lower back pain is a cluster of active conditions, not a neglected corner. Successful and income are both listed as misses on the strict reading that neither is established: he works in IT consulting as what appears to be an employee, no income was discussed, no price was presented, and he is the sole earner for a household of seven. That is an absence of evidence and should be revisited after the second call, but nothing in the transcript supports 'they own their own business, or they're a physician, something along those lines.' The finding that matters is not the score but what was done with it. The rep recognised the mismatch explicitly and argued past it: 'I've never met somebody who's coming to Trevor's program being, you know, for lack of a better term, big-boned and struggling with, like, obesity their entire life. And who's actually followed the system. And not seen absolutely incredible results.' That is a deliberate decision to sell to the profile the stated ICP was written to exclude, made in the same terms the ICP uses. Taken with the Eddie call two days earlier, this batch contains two full-length closer conversations with prospects the stated ICP excludes on the weight and starting-point criteria, and neither was routed to the cheaper product that the sales manager described internally as where such prospects usually go. Meanwhile the two prospects who scored core did not close. The stated ICP is not being applied as a filter at any point in this pipeline.
